title: Tom and the Comic Strip
text:
Tom likes comic strips. Every Sunday, he reads them in the newspaper. His favorite comic strip has a dog named Max. Max is funny and very smart. Tom laughs every time he reads it.

Tom wants to draw a comic strip too. He has a notebook and two red pencils. First, he draws a small house. Then, he draws Max in the garden. His sister says the comic is very good.

questions.text: On which day does Tom read comic strips?
How many red pencils does Tom have?
Why does Tom laugh when he reads his favorite comic strip?
options: Because the comic is too long

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel about drawing a comic strip?
options: He does not want to try it

vocabulary.definition: a story told in pictures, often funny
the one that you like the most
a small book for writing or drawing in
makes a sound because something is funny

paragraph_translations: Tom çizgi romanları sever. Her Pazar, onları gazetede okur. En sevdiği çizgi romanda Max adında bir köpek vardır. Max komik ve çok akıllıdır. Tom onu okuduğu her seferinde güler.
Tom da bir çizgi roman çizmek istiyor. Bir defteri ve iki kırmızı kalemi var. Önce küçük bir ev çizer. Sonra bahçede Max'i çizer. Kız kardeşi çizgi romanın çok iyi olduğunu söylüyor.
